The '''ASP-19, Lightsaber Training Configuration, Mark IX''' was a [[Training droid/Legends|training droid]] modified after the standard [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] [[ASP-19 battle droid/Legends|ASP-19 battle droid]] for [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] training purposes. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] personally designed the modified units for his personal use.
